company_name: The United Laboratories International Holdings Limited

equity_bridge.item: FY2025 final dividend payable at 30 June 2026 (RMB26c x 1,972.6m), paid July 2026
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet line 290 'Dividend payables 512,987'. The cash is in the 30 June balance but left in July; deduct so net cash is not overstated.
H1 FY2026 interim line 342; flows are consolidated so NCI is deducted once here.

equity_bridge.item: UBT251 (Novo Nordisk, ex-Greater China) risk-adjusted near-term development/regulatory milestones
equity_bridge.note: Of the US$1.8bn headline milestone pool, most is sales-based. Assumes ~US$300m of development/regulatory milestones (Phase III initiation, NDA filings, US/EU approvals) at ~40% cumulative probability of success for a Phase II-complete obesity asset, discounted 3-5 years at 9.5%: ~US$85m x 6.67 ~= RMB570m, rounded to RMB600m (RMB0.30/sh, HK$0.36/sh). Sales milestones and tiered royalties are excluded here and appear ONLY in the bull-case growth/margin path from FY2031. A US$15m (RMB101.9m) Phase II milestone was booked in H1 FY2026 and received July 2026.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Base-case 10-year average of the driver path (2.5% FY2026 rising to 5% in FY2028-29, fading to 2.5%). Anchored to the ex-licence 5-year revenue CAGR of 6.05% (FY2020-25) haircut for structural VBP/API price deflation; not to the equity CAGR, which is inflated by the July 2025 placing and peak-cycle FY2023-24 retained earnings.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-yr CAGR 15.1% diverges >30% from revenue 5-yr CAGR 8.5% (6.1% ex-licence): the gap is the HK$2.2bn (~RMB2.0bn) July 2025 placing plus FY2023-24 peak-cycle earnings retained ahead of the FY2025 capex surge, not organic compounding. EPS 5-yr CAGR 22.7% is measured from the FY2020 cycle trough to a licence-inflated FY2025 and is not a forward rate.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC (interest income sits outside OCF for this filer, see inputs.interest_income_note). FCF CAGRs are negative (-12.1% 3-yr, -3.8% 5-yr) despite revenue growing because capex rose from 538 (FY2020) to 2,886 (FY2025); on an ex-licence basis FY2025 owner FCF was -592.9. SBC is immaterial (0.1% of revenue), so the SBC-adjusted and reported FCF CAGRs are within 0.1pp -- SBC is not where the cash went; capex is.

scenario_narratives.base: Trough-to-mid-cycle recovery. Underlying revenue (ex-licence) is flat today; it grows 2.5-5% on antibiotics finished products, animal health (+46% in H1 FY2026), insulin exports and domestic GLP-1 launches, while 6-APA/bulk medicine stop falling by FY2027. EBITDA margin ex-interest recovers from a 14.5% FY2026 trough to 19% by FY2030 -- a mid-cycle level below both the FY2017-25 average (~21%) and the FY2023-24 peak (28%). The capex build-out (Inner Mongolia, Gaolan Port) completes by FY2027 and capex converges on D&A. UBT251 contributes only risk-adjusted development milestones; no royalties. Weighted-average growth 3.7%.
scenario_narratives.bull: API upcycle plus pipeline. Antibiotic/6-APA pricing turns in FY2027 as overcapacity clears, margins rebuild toward 24% by FY2032 (still under the FY2023-24 peak), insulin and GLP-1 (liraglutide, semaglutide) win domestic tenders and exports, animal health keeps compounding, and UBT251 succeeds at Novo Nordisk so sales milestones and royalties on ex-China sales arrive from FY2031. Requires three independent things to go right -- the cycle, domestic GLP-1 commercialisation and a Phase III readout -- which is why the bull weight is below the house default.
scenario_narratives.bear: Structural deflation. VBP rounds keep cutting antibiotic and insulin prices, the API cycle never recovers because Chinese capacity additions (including this Group's own) hold the market in oversupply, revenue shrinks then crawls at 2%, EBITDA margin stays at the H1 FY2026 trough (12.5%) and reaches only 14%, committed capex completes into weak demand, and the H1 FY2026 cash-conversion failure (OCF RMB34.7m) recurs as working capital absorbs growth. The RMB5.1bn of net cash and a 10x terminal cap keep the bear value above zero, but the shareholder gets little more than net cash plus a low-margin, no-growth API business.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the business on normalised (mid-cycle, ex-licence, ex-interest) earnings power, not the FY2025 peak that a one-off RMB1.44bn licence fee and the tail of an API upcycle produced. The FY2025 base revenue strips the licence fee; the margin path starts at the H1 FY2026 trough and recovers only to a mid-cycle level below the long-run average. Net cash is credited once (in the bridge, with interest income kept out of the flows because this filer books it in investing), the July 2026 dividend and NCI are deducted, and UBT251 is carried as a small risk-adjusted development-milestone item with royalties confined to the bull case. Risk is charged in the scenario weights (30/50/20), not in a stacked WACC.
key_risks_to_valuation: API price cycle: 6-APA and amoxicillin pricing drive segment profit swings of 50-80% a year; the base case assumes recovery to mid-cycle, which has not yet started.
VBP / national centralised procurement: repeated mandated price cuts on antibiotics and insulin; management calls this 'normalised', i.e. structural.

Cash conversion: H1 FY2026 OCF of RMB34.7m on RMB347.6m of profit, receivables and inventory building, RMB1.81bn of bills endorsed with recourse and RMB2.39bn of supplier-finance payables; if the stricter company net-cash definition is used every scenario falls HK$1.42/sh.
Capex and leverage: borrowings doubled to RMB5.9bn with RMB1.04bn of contracted capex outstanding; the model assumes capex converges on D&A by FY2032.
UBT251 clinical and partner risk: the RMB600m bridge item and the bull-case royalties both depend on Novo Nordisk continuing and succeeding in Phase III.
FX: a CNY-built model quoted in HKD; the fx_rate (1.175) is not refreshed by price-only updates.
Terminal multiple: cyclical name with a historical P/E of 5-8x; the 13x FCF cap, not Gordon growth, binds in the base case.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2025 external sales EXCLUDING the RMB1,442.2m Novo Nordisk UBT251 upfront licence fee (FY2025 AR segment note line 4905: External sales 11,768,417 RMB'000; reported revenue 13,210,627 = 11,768,417 + licence fee 1,442,210). The licence fee is a one-off and is not a revenue base to compound from. Cross-check: H1 FY2026 external sales 6,064.1 vs H1 FY2025 ex-licence 6,084.8 (-0.3% YoY) -- the headline -18.0% is entirely the absent licence fee; underlying revenue is flat.
inputs.share_count_basis: Weighted average = shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim line 1169: 1,972,631k); the interim states no potential ordinary shares exist, so basic = diluted. Held FLAT: SBC (RMB14m, 0.1% of revenue) is expensed in the flows and funded by trustee market purchases. The 2.75m shares bought back in June and cancelled in July 2026 (0.14%) are ignored. The July 2025 HK$2.2bn placing (+155.7m shares) is already in the count.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 interim balance sheet. total_debt = borrowings 5,924.423 (1,180.823 current + 4,743.600 non-current) + lease liabilities 23.892 (4.040 + 19.852). cash = cash and cash equivalents 11,069.413 only; pledged bank deposits of 660.248 are EXCLUDED (collateral for bills/banking facilities). Trade payables under supplier finance arrangement of 2,389.287 (1,476.905 + 912.382) are NOT treated as debt here -- they are non-interest-bearing operating payables whose turnover sits in working capital -- but the company's own 'net cash' deducts them (RMB3,416.0m at 30 June 2026 vs RMB4,027.1m at FY2025). Deducting them would cut every scenario by RMB1.21/sh = HK$1.42/sh; a reader who prefers the stricter definition should apply that haircut. Bills receivable endorsed to suppliers with full recourse (RMB1,810.0m) are derecognised contingents and are not adjusted.
inputs.last_fcf_note: last_fcf = reported FCF 863.364 - SBC 14.093 - interest_income 0 = 849.271 (FY2025). It INCLUDES the RMB1,442.2m licence receipt (collected in H1 FY2025) and FY2025's peak capex of 2,886.5 (PP&E 2,726.7 + deposits 75.8 + intangibles 84.0): ex-licence, FY2025 owner FCF was -592.9. Neither figure is a run-rate; the forward build is from components. H1 FY2026 owner FCF was -442.6 (OCF 34.7 on a working-capital build, capex 472.9).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash-flow reconciliation line 2970 'Share-based payment expense 14,093' (RMB'000); FY2024 47,364; FY2023 6,365. No cash taxes on equity awards -- the share award scheme is funded by trustee on-market purchases, not net-share settlement. Near SBC-zero: house and street bases almost coincide.
inputs.interest_income_note: Bank interest income was RMB152.573m in FY2025 (H1 FY2026: 85.397m) and net cash is >5x the FCF base, so the stripping rule applies -- but for this filer it is ALREADY outside reported FCF: the FY2025 cash-flow statement backs 'Bank interest income (152,573)' out of operating cash flow (line 2968) and shows 'Interest received 152,573' under INVESTING activities (line 3019). Reported FCF = OCF - capex therefore excludes it, and deducting it again would double-count. Forward EBITDA margin paths are built ex-interest income (and ex-licence fee) for the same reason; the cash pile is credited once, in net_debt.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow for share repurchases RMB41.553m (FY2024 36.577m; H1 FY2026 19.766m). Small but real: the flat count is partly funded. Dividends paid FY2025 RMB1,042.5m (RMB26c final + RMB16c interim on the pre-placing count); no H1 FY2026 interim dividend was declared.
inputs.fx_note: HKD per CNY 1.175 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-23T08:11Z). Model values are built in CNY and multiplied by 1.175 to the HKD quote. Direction cross-check via USD legs the same day: USDHKD 7.8404 / USDCNY 6.67 = 1.1755 (0.05% tie). No dual listing exists for a price parity check; the FY2025 final dividend is declared in RMB cents only. fx_rate is not moved by refresh_price.py -- re-derive it on any later price-only refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10-year CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.1 x China equity risk premium ~7.0% (mature-market ~4.5% + country/H-share premium ~2.5%) = ~9.5% cost of equity. Net cash, so WACC = cost of equity; the 1.9-2.7% floating-rate RMB borrowings are not a meaningful cheaper leg. 9.5% is used in ALL THREE scenarios: API-price cyclicality, VBP tendering risk, cash-conversion quality and UBT251 clinical risk are carried in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB23.9m included in total_debt; lease principal repayments (RMB5.1m FY2025) are NOT deducted from the flows. Immaterial either way (0.04% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated/unlevered; non-controlling interests of RMB78.9m (30 June 2026) deducted once in the equity bridge. NCI share of profit is 0.5-1% -- immaterial.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating pharmaceutical manufacturer: antibiotic intermediates/6-APA, amoxicillin API, finished products incl. insulin, animal health). Not a bank/REIT/LIC. First valuation of this ticker. NORMALISATION: FY2025 revenue/EBITDA/NI are inflated by the one-off RMB1,442.2m Novo Nordisk UBT251 upfront licence fee (US$180m net of Danish WHT) and FY2023-24 were the peak of the amoxicillin/6-APA price cycle (EBITDA margin 28.6-28.9% vs 16.5-23.8% in FY2017-22 and 14.0% in FY2025 ex-licence, ex-interest). The base revenue is FY2025 ex-licence (11,768.4) and the margin paths start from the H1 FY2026 trough (EBITDA ex-milestone, ex-interest 12.1%; 15.0% ex the RMB178m unallocated FX loss) and recover to a mid-cycle 19% ex-interest by FY2030 -- below the FY2017-25 ex-licence/ex-interest average of ~21% to respect management's 'normalised' VBP pricing language. Future UBT251 sales milestones/royalties are NOT in base flows (bull case only); near-term development/regulatory milestones are a single risk-adjusted equity-bridge item. Capex is in a build-out cycle (FY2025 2,886; RMB1,044m still contracted at 30 June 2026) funded by the July 2025 placing, so capex runs well above D&A through FY2027 before converging to ~6.8% of revenue vs D&A ~7%. Cash tax 21% of EBIT (FY2024 cash rate 20%; FY2025 26% distorted by licence-fee tax; PRC 25% statutory with 15% HNTE subsidiaries). Working capital: receivables+inventory (7,839) ~= payables (7,830) at 30 June 2026, so growth consumes little cash; -5% capture in base/bull, -10% in bear to reflect the H1 FY2026 build (receivables +317, inventories +271, payables -251). PRICE: regular-session print; 52-week range 6.67-13.72, the stock has halved from its March 2026 post-licence high. Market cap at the quote is ~RMB11.5bn, 0.67x book.

bear.narrative: VBP 'normalisation' is structural, not cyclical: the 2026 LC-YPJX-2026-1 round cuts prices on 13 products, the API cycle does not recover because Chinese capacity (including the Group's own new plants) keeps the market oversupplied, 6-APA and bulk medicine stay at FY2025-26 pricing, insulin loses share to Tonghua Dongbao/Gan & Lee. Revenue falls 3% in FY2026 and 1% in FY2027 before crawling at 2%. EBITDA margin (ex-interest) stays at the H1 FY2026 trough of 12.5% and only reaches 14% by FY2031. Capex stays above D&A through FY2030 as committed capacity is completed into weak demand, and the H1 FY2026 working-capital build (OCF RMB34.7m on RMB348m of profit) recurs, so growth consumes 10% of incremental revenue. UBT251 development milestones are still in the bridge; no royalties. 2.0% terminal growth, 10x cap -- the multiple the market has historically paid this name.

base.narrative: FY2026 revenue ~RMB12.06bn (+2.5% on the ex-licence base: H1 6,166 incl. the 102m milestone, H2 ~5,900 as 6-APA keeps falling while antibiotics finished products +6% and animal health +46% hold the top line). EBITDA margin (ex-interest) troughs at 14.5% in FY2026 and recovers to a 19% mid-cycle by FY2030 as the API price cycle normalises from its FY2025-26 low, GLP-1 domestic launches (liraglutide approved Sept 2025, semaglutide NDA) and insulin exports add higher-margin mix, and the Inner Mongolia / Gaolan Port capacity is absorbed. Capex 10.5% of revenue in FY2026 (RMB1.04bn contracted) falling to 6.8% by FY2032, slightly below D&A of 7% as the build-out ends. Terminal 2.5% nominal CNY growth; 13x FCF cap for a cyclical API manufacturer.

bull.narrative: Amoxicillin/6-APA prices turn up from FY2027 as Chinese industry overcapacity clears (FY2023-24 showed what the upcycle does: 28% EBITDA margins), insulin wins volume in the 2026 follow-up procurement and exports keep growing, liraglutide/semaglutide build a domestic GLP-1 franchise, animal health compounds at 20%+, and UBT251 clears Phase III at Novo Nordisk so sales milestones and tiered royalties on ex-China net sales start in FY2031 (the 7-8% growth from FY2028 and the 24% mature margin carry that royalty stream -- royalties are near-100% margin). Mature margin 24% is still below the FY2023-24 peak. 3.0% terminal growth, 14x cap.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: the H1 FY2026 evidence (underlying revenue flat, EBITDA margin at a decade trough, OCF collapse to RMB34.7m on a working-capital build, borrowings doubled, interim dividend suspended) is consistent with the bear path, VBP is a single-regulator dependency management itself describes as 'normalised', and the API price cycle has shown no sign of turning. Bull cut from 35% to 20% because it needs the API upcycle, domestic GLP-1 commercialisation and a UBT251 Phase III success to all land. Base 50%: the balance sheet (RMB5.1bn net cash, 0.67x book) means the mid-cycle recovery does not depend on financing.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
